<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_USI_CourseRegistration"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/usi/course-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USI_CourseRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI Course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RegisterCourse" name="Register for course requested"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckSlots" name="Check free slots"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsSplit" name="Slots free?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoSlots" name="No free slots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCourses" name="Show courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course and date"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check for existing account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountSplit" name="Has account?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckUniversity" name="Check eligible university"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_UniversitySplit" name="Eligible university?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ActivationResponse" messageRef="Message_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountJoin" name="Account available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetSplit" name="Invite friends?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetJoin" name="Continue registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TicketIssued" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_RegisterCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckSlots" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit" targetRef="End_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsSplit" targetRef="Task_ShowCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ShowCourses" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_UniversitySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversitySplit" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversitySplit" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountJoin" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_TweetSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetSplit" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetSplit" targetRef="Gateway_TweetJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Gateway_TweetJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="End_TicketIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
